priority_items.title: Lal: 24 Dec CRC in-force clock 'autogolpe' if it delays the GE; still not extra-constitutional
priority_items.summary: Near-cutoff FijiVillage homepage lead (dateline 17 Sep): Centre for Democracy and Dialogue CEO Nilesh Lal says the proposed 24 Dec 2026 in-force timetable raises serious constitutional/legal/democratic concerns; if electoral-system change makes an on-time GE impossible it would amount in substance to an autogolpe. Asks a public guarantee that the election is held in the legal window. Civil-society CLAIM, not an extra-constitutional act. CRC report unpublished; Referendum Bill unpassed; fiji.gov.fj news list still silent. Special sitting still 22 Sep 11:30. Not FLASH.
